pick.headline: Space shuttle Atlantis docks with Mir

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Central Eurasia, No. 125, 29 June 1995
evidence.snippet: …ng part in the meeting of what is known as the Gore-Chernomyrdin Commission is the main purpose of the vice president’s current four-day official visit to Moscow.
